O: a call for hands comes first and a report of that mark's state follows it, so {el}'s order is shown; a specification
BOUND-S: the call itself reports a start or progress already placed, or a report comes before any call, so the call recruits to a mark already started: the bound's pattern; {el}'s order is not shown
BOUND-L: the call is to finish, repair, defend, extend or improve a mark already placed, so it recruits to a mark already started: the bound's pattern; {el}'s order is not shown
NS: what follows the call reports no state of the mark (a join, a pledge, a cheer, advice or a layout), so P03's end is not shown and {el}'s order is not shown
ONE: only one end is shown, a report or joins with no call, or a call with no report; {el}'s order is not shown
OTHER: {el}'s order is not shown on this canvas
